SELECT PTL_FEE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID ptlId, ptl.PORTFOLIO_NAME portFolioName,
PSA.ACCT_NO secAcctId,
PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_PLACE,
sum(IFNULL(PTL_FEE_POSITION.TDY_ACCUMUL_PAY_FEE,0)) payAmt, sum(IFNULL(PTL_FEE_POSITION.TDY_ACCUMUL_PAY_FEE,0)) actPayAmt FROM PTL_FEE_POSITION LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ptl ON PTL_FEE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = ptl.PORTFOLIO_ID
LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_ACCT PSA ON PSA.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_FEE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SSAI ON SSAI.SEC_ACCT_ID = PSA.ACCT_NO AND SSAI.REGIST_ORG = PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_PLACE
WHERE PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_TYPE = #{feeType1} AND PTL_FEE_POSITION.CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cdate}, '%Y-%m-%d')-1
AND PSA.ACCT_NO = #{secAcctId}
AND PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_PLACE = '999999'
group by PTL_FEE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID, ptl.PORTFOLIO_NAME
,PSA.ACCT_NO
,PTL_FEE_POSITION.PTL_FEE_PLACE
having sum(IFNULL(PTL_FEE_POSITION.TDY_ACCUMUL_PAY_FEE,0)) > 0
SELECT PAY_CYCLE FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE WHERE CASH_ID = #{cashId} and eff_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') LIMIT 1

select dat.resiPrincipal from ( select psp.AMOUNT resiPrincipal from PTL_CASH_POSITION psp
where psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{ptlId} and psp.CDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{payDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from PTL_CASH_POSITION temp where temp.PORTFOLIO_ID = psp.PORTFOLIO_ID
and temp.CDATE> psp.CDATE AND temp.CDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{payDate},'%Y-%m-%d') ) order by psp.CDATE desc )dat where LIMIT 1

SELECT count(*) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN inner JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO ON FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID inner JOIN MST_FEEINFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID AND MST_FEEINFO.CHARGE_TYPE = #{chargeType_01} and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdate},'%Y-%m-%d') and (CASE WHEN MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE = #{feeType_03} THEN 0 WHEN #{feeType_04} THEN 0 WHEN #{feeType_12} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CASH_ID AND FIN_CASH_PLAN.Mdate = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = #{ps_C11} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = #{noFlag} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus_01} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId})

select DISTINCT TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secAcctId, (CASE WHEN MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID = NULL THEN MST_FEEINFO1.FEE_ID ELSE MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID END) as feeId,
(CASE WHEN MST_FEEINFO.FEE_NAME = NULL THEN MST_FEEINFO1.FEE_NAME ELSE MST_FEEINFO.FEE_NAME END) as feeName,
(CASE WHEN MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE = NULL THEN MST_FEEINFO1.FEE_TYPE ELSE MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE END) as feeType, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.VDATE vdate, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.MDATE mdate, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.CASH_ID cashId, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID tradeId, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY ccy from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ON TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE ON TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = PTL_TRADE.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.CASH_ID AND FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} LEFT JOIN MST_FEEINFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_FEEINFO MST_FEEINFO1 ON TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO1.FEE_ID where TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

select FIN_PRODUCT.CCY as ccy , FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.PROFIT_TYPE as profitType, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE as dealMode, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE, mdate from FIN_PRODUCT, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD
where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID
and FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{ptlId}
LIMIT 1
